Edit this (or the recipes in the Knowledge Repository) and re-run the sync — the dashboard regenerates. Prose heuristics remain the human source of truth; this is their structured shadow.

coupling._source: Interpretation-Heuristics §4 — the six axes are competing constraints, not independent dials.

pairs.why: protect aromatics vs reach the sugars
chasing clean sweetness trades away body
the strong antagonists — pull opposite ways

radar_interpretation.meaning: Desired sensory priorities; not guarantees, independent extraction controls, fixed recipe deltas, or a zero-sum budget.
radar_interpretation.coupling_rule: Dragging one axis visibly updates synergistic and antagonistic axes using the coupling matrix. Display the resulting values; never hide the coupled movement.
radar_interpretation.conflict_rule: Note conflict only when opposing priorities are both extreme, equipment cannot support both, and compromise materially weakens both.
radar_interpretation.flat_rule: Preserve baseline character; optimise coherence and evenness with small balancing changes.

keywords._note: Synonyms used to infer process/roast from a pasted coffee description when the dropdowns are left empty. First match wins (longest phrases first).

grind._note: Concrete grind/temp starting points by roast, used to build the General Advice headline. Grind is described relative to a filter/V60 baseline.

Light.grind: grind fine (finer than your usual filter setting)

Medium-dark.grind: grind one step coarser than medium

coach.rule: Assume professional barista competence. State only the highest-leverage action. Omit standard technique, definitions, and rationale unless it changes execution.

pouring.rule: All displayed pour targets round up to the next 5 g. Recipe precision must never create impractical pour targets.

optimisation.grind_mapping_rule: Use grinder-specific values only when a calibration mapping exists; otherwise return qualitative direction and unavailable mapping.
